title: Day list
summary: Six animals from one real place. Work out where in the world somebody was standing.
intro: Half of birding is working out what you're likely to see before you've seen it, and that habit is hard to switch off. Give me a list of what somebody found and I'll start guessing where they were. This is that, as a puzzle. Six species from one real place, handed over one at a time, commonest in the world first. Drop a pin where you think they were standing and name the month.
